fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Livestock Extension Officer Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of Livestock Extension Officer on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 1251 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Livestock Extension Officer Recruitment 2026 will start from 09 September 2026, and candidates can apply until 29 September 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for UPSSSC Livestock Extension Officer Recruitment 2026 given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 September 2026
  • Last Date : 29 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 September 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 06 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

  • Download Official Notification
  • Official Website
